page.overview:
What is Glitchtrap?

Glitchtrap, known in game as The Anomaly, is a secondary antagonist of the Steel Wool series of the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise. It is the main antagonist of the Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted duology, as well as the overarching antagonist of Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach.

Glitchtrap takes on the form of a person wearing a Spring Bonnie costume - who is a grinning, bipedal, golden-yellow rabbit. He wears a purple star-speckled vest, a purple bow tie, and two black buttons near the top of their chest. He also has stitches stretching across his waving hand. He initially appears translucent, progressing into a less-spectral form over time.

He also possesses vivid purple eyes with small pupils, which are the first thing visible when he starts to appear to the player's right. In Blacklight Mode, His eyes will turn blue with white, circular pupils. He also have large whiskers on each side of his face, three eyelashes on both of his eyes, and large arching eyebrows.

Glitchtrap's personality remains enigmatic and largely unknown. He is almost entirely silent, with his sole voice line being "I always come back. Let me out." as heard in the Princess Quest minigame. However, judging by his mannerisms in Help Wanted's Pizza Party minigame, he's seemingly very sadistic as evidenced by him dancing around the lobby in Help Wanted after stuffing the player inside a Freddy suit. He also influences Vanessa into looking up various torture methods such as the blood eagle and making her purchase thumbscrews.

Also known as: Malhare.
